subject: Novaparts Zip portal: duplicate login preventing PO submission
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaparts.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Novaparts Procurement <procurement@novaparts.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unable to submit PO — account mismatch on Zip portal

Hi Priya,

We're blocked submitting PO #NP-3382 via the Zip supplier portal. When I try to finalize the PO I get a modal that says 'Account not authorized to submit POs for this buyer' and the UI shows my profile twice (one from SSO, one from local signup). I attached a screenshot (screenshot-login-error.png) and the PO PDF so you can see the flow.

We originally signed up with Google SSO (liam@novaparts.com) but at some point I accepted an invite using an alias (liam.oconnor@novaparts.com). It looks like Zip created two identities and the PO routing is tied to the SSO identity while my session is using the alias.

Can Redwood escalate this? We need to submit by EOD tomorrow for a vendor cutoff.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Lead, Novaparts
liam.oconnor@novaparts.com

Thanks for the details, Liam — sorry for the blocker. Quick triage notes below and next steps so we can get you unblocked today: 

- Confirmed receipt of your attachments (screenshot + sample PO).
- Immediate hypothesis: duplicate account created (SSO-backed identity vs invite-linked alias). PO routing is bound to the SSO identity.

Can you confirm the email you usually use to sign in (liam@novaparts.com vs liam.oconnor@novaparts.com)? If you can, try signing out and explicitly using the Google SSO button (not the email/password flow) and let me know if the SSO session shows your corporate profile.

I'll loop in Zip support and ask them to either merge the two identities or temporarily map the alias to the buyer-facing identity so you can submit. In parallel we can approve the PO manually if needed — please confirm the PO number and target vendor so I can start a manual approval.

I'll follow up with Zip and post their ticket link here.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan

From: support@zipportal.com

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Novaparts — duplicate identity / alias causing PO submission block (ZX-2291)

Hi Liam / Ben / Priya,

Thanks for the report — this came in as ticket ZX-2291. We investigated and confirmed duplicate identities for that user. We merged the alias account (liam.oconnor@novaparts.com) into the SSO-backed identity (liam@novaparts.com) for tenant NOV-7782. Changes are live.

Action items for the user:
- Please sign out of the Zip portal completely, clear your browser cache (or use an incognito window), then sign in using the Google SSO button (liam@novaparts.com).
- If you still see the blocker, reply with a screenshot of the profile tile.

We've also added a short-lived mapping so that any ongoing sessions for the alias are treated as the merged identity for 24 hours to avoid immediate blocking during the cutover.

If you'd like a permanent account-merge export for your records, we can generate one (ID merge report attached to the ticket).

Regards,
Zip Portal Support
support@zipportal.com
